name: greedy_coloring
author: f28f69d7
description: Assigns colors to graph nodes so adjacent nodes have different colors, using deterministic largest-degree-first greedy coloring. Use it for conflict-free exam slots or other scheduling questions. Works on directed or undirected graphs; directed edges are treated as conflicts in either direction and weights are ignored. Returns the number of colors used across the whole graph and up to top_k labeled node assignments.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to color.

top_k.description: Maximum number of node-color assignments to show, sorted by node ID. The color count still covers the whole graph.
